en-US.mod.fourwaysplitter.title: Four-Way Splitter
en-US.mod.fourwaysplitter.description: Splits the four quadrants of an incoming shape to four cardinal outputs on the upper platform level.
en-US.building-variant.four-way-splitter.title: Four-Way Splitter
en-US.building-variant.four-way-splitter.descr:
Splits an incoming shape into its four per-quadrant copies, each flowing out a different cardinal output on the upper platform level.

Quadrant mapping: TR → North, BR → East, BL → South, TL → West. Multi-layer shapes preserve their vertical structure per quadrant.

Accepts standard solid shapes only; crystals, fluids, and pins will back up on the input belt.
